title: webappctl start fails: 'Too many levels of symbolic links'
description_md:
The `webapp` service won't start. `webappctl start` fails immediately trying to read its own config, complaining about `Too many levels of symbolic links` -- not a missing file, not a permissions error. A deploy script that was supposed to point the active config at a real profile directory clearly went wrong. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out what the active config symlink is actually pointing at, fix it, and get the service running.

You're done when the `webapp-worker` process is actually running.
